candidats.titre: File:Flickr - Official U.S. Navy Imagery - Sailors pour concrete during a construction project in Djibouti..jpg
candidats.description: DJIBOUTI (Jan. 20, 2011) Builder Constructionmen Diana Aceves, right, and Daniel Fuentes, both assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion (NMCB) 74, Detail Horn of Africa, pour concrete during a construction project at Ecole 5 Primary School. NMCB-74 is deployed to Combined Joint Task Force-Horn of Africa to assist in promoting regional stability by providing construction engineering support for schools, medical clinics, water wells and other civic improvements throughout the region. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Michael Lindsey/Released)
categories: Photographs by the United States Navy

candidats.titre: File:Douda de Ecole Primary School in Grande Douda Djibouti construction on March 18 2009.jpg
candidats.description: U.S. Navy Petty Officer 3rd Class Gwennette Jamerson, assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion 11, settles concrete during construction of a pad at the Douda de Ecole Primary School in Grande Douda, Djibouti, on March 18, 2009. The pad will support a new water storage tank, which will provide the school with approximately 1,500 liters of water per day.
